source_units: is a free variable-band sidechain dynamics plug-in with compression, expansion, flexible matrix routing, Tone Shaper mode, and Inverse sidechain mode. Each band can listen to the internal signal, external sidechain input, or another band, so you can create targeted ducking and inter-band control without compressing the whole mix.
AU / VST3 for macOS 11 or later
, with a Tone mode bug fix.

Create precise ducking (e.g., kick → bass low band) and inter-band control (e.g., harsh band → tame presence) without affecting the entire spectrum.
